description: This file defines an abstract class `BaseJavaEventAdapter` used for listening to UDP broadcast events over multicast, decoding JSON payloads into `JavaEvent` objects, and notifying registered listeners. It manages event reception via a dedicated thread, supports direct in-process event handling, and maintains a mapping of service IDs to multiple adapter instances.

classes.name: BaseJavaEventAdapter
classes.description: Abstract class for listening to UDP multicast events, decoding JSON payloads into JavaEvent objects, and managing associated listeners and event processing.

classes.name: ServiceAdapterSet
classes.description: A thread-safe collection that groups multiple `BaseJavaEventAdapter` instances for a single service ID and forwards incoming JSON events to all contained adapters.

classes.name: EventReaderThread
classes.description: A singleton background thread responsible for listening on a multicast socket, receiving event datagrams, parsing them into JSON, and dispatching them to appropriate service adapters based on service ID.

methods.name: BaseJavaEventAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the adapter with a service ID, setting up static environment, and registering with service registry or directly with event producer if in the same process.

methods.name: addBaseEventListener
methods.description: Registers a listener object to receive events from this adapter.

methods.name: removeEventListener
methods.description: Unregisters a listener object so it no longer receives events.

methods.name: listenerCount
methods.description: Returns the current number of registered listeners.

methods.name: processIncomingEvent
methods.description: Handles an incoming JSON payload, extracts event codes, verifies support, decodes into a JavaEvent, and dispatches to listeners.

methods.name: getLog
methods.description: Abstract method for subclasses to provide logging capability.

methods.name: supportsEvent
methods.description: Abstract method to determine if a specific event code/value is supported.

methods.name: decodeEvent
methods.description: Abstract method for subclasses to decode JSON payloads into JavaEvent instances.

methods.name: notifyListener
methods.description: Abstract method for delivering the JavaEvent to a specific listener.

methods.name: finishCanceling
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to perform cleanup during shutdown.

methods.name: notifyAllListeners
methods.description: Schedules delivery of a JavaEvent to all registered listeners via a thread pool.
